messages:
maddie: quick alert — noticed ~8-12% latency tail increase on Mistral-7B int8 after the kernel-selector change last night. CI perf dashboard shows it starting at 03:12 UTC.
ryan_h: ugh, saw that too. is this only on long-context workloads or across the board?
maddie: mostly >1k context, KV-heavy traces. short requests (~64 tokens) look fine.
alex_ng: can you paste the profiler snapshot? need kernel timelines + batch sizes.
maddie: pasted the high-level slice (trimmed):
```
PROFILE: 2027-11-21T03:15
model: mistral-7b-awq-int8
seq_len: 1536
batch: mean 4 (p95 8)
kernel_select: fused-attn-v2 (fallback: generic-attn)
kv_cache_hits: 0.73
kv_evictions: 0.12
token_ms: 9.8 -> p99 42.1
note: kernel-v2 shows higher setup latency for sequences >1024
```
ryan_h: interesting — kernel `fused-attn-v2` has a higher setup cost for long sequences due to extra ROPE tiling. that could explain tail.
tiana: is ROPE scaling different between Mistral and Mixtral configs? we have a custom rope-scale factor in the mixtral profile.
alex_ng: yes, Mistral patch uses linear-rope scale 1.0; Mixtral profile uses 0.9 to reduce positional overflow on int8. but AWQ calibration can amplify sensitivity.
maddie: also saw a tiny accuracy delta on the calibration prompts after switching to fused-attn-v2 + AWQ int8: ~0.6% drop on math QA set. not catastrophic but correlates with the perf bump.
perf-bot: deploy-bot: Canary job #467 finished — latency regression detected (+9.8% p99) vs baseline. See /ci/perf/467.
ryan_h: what's the calibration prompt set used for AWQ? maybe quant errors manifest in long-kv patterns.
maddie: calibration file: `calib-long-kv.txt` includes repeated-prefix prompts to warm KV and stress RoPE:
```
PROMPT-1: "Translate the following paragraph and then summarize..." (repeat 3x, 1200 tokens total)
PROMPT-2: "Chain of thought: compute prime factors for numbers up to 1000" (to stress math tokens)
```
alex_ng: can we repro locally with `--kernel=fused-attn-v2` and `--rope-scale=1.0` and compare to `--kernel=generic` and `--rope-scale=0.95`? I'll run an instrumented job.
tiana: also try disabling auto-prefix-batching in the scheduler. the new batching heuristic concatenates KV prefixes aggressively which might increase kernel setup frequency.
ryan_h: good point — we changed the scheduler to prefer packing small short requests into partial KV batches which increases number of micro-batches for long sequences. that interacts badly with kernels that have per-batch setup overhead.
maddie: experiment matrix I propose:
- A: fused-attn-v2, rope=1.0, scheduler=v2 (current)
- B: generic-attn, rope=1.0, scheduler=v2
- C: fused-attn-v2, rope=0.95, scheduler=v1 (pack-less)
- D: fused-attn-v2, rope=1.0, scheduler=v2 but AWQ calibration re-run with long-kv prompts removed
run 200 traces each, measure p50/p95/p99, kv_evictions, kernel_setup_ms.
perf-bot: perf-runner queued experiment A-D as job 468 (ETA 14m).
alex_ng: started local run for A/B now. attaching tail of kernel timeline:
```
[ 0.00s ] prepare_kv_buffer (120ms)
[ 0.12s ] fused-attn-v2::init_kernels (220ms)
[ 0.34s ] fused-attn-v2::run (0.8ms/token)
```
ryan_h: init_kernels 220ms is suspiciously high vs generic-attn which has almost no init. likely memory layout transformations for AWQ kernels.
maddie: if init is unavoidable for fused-attn-v2, maybe we want to bias scheduler to batch into fewer but larger batches (reduce freq of init). can we change batching heuristic to prefer concatenation of same-model/same-rope batches?
tiana: yes, add a warmup-aware scoring: prefer coalescing traces with similar rope-scale and kernel candidate. fallback to current only when latency SLO permits. low-risk change toggled behind flag.
perf-bot: job 468 finished. summary: A p99 +10%, B p99 +2%, C p99 +3%, D p99 +4%. accuracy deltas: A -0.6%, B -0.2%, C -0.4%, D -0.1%.
ryan_h: that suggests the fused-attn-v2 kernel initialization cost is the main perf hit; changing rope-scale helps a bit; re-calibration helps accuracy.
alex_ng: proposal: revert kernel-selector to prefer generic-attn for sequences >1024 for AWQ int8 Mistral until we can optimize init path. simultaneously re-run AWQ calib without long-kv prompts to see if accuracy recovers on fused path.
maddie: agreed. will rollout a canary that pins generic-attn for seq>1024 and enable warmup-aware batching behind a flag. will also open a perf-card for optimizing fused-attn init.
tiana: filing the perf-card and adding owners: @alex_ng, @ryan_h.
perf-bot: ticket created: PERF-1029 "fused-attn-v2 init optimization" assigned to alex_ng.
ryan_h: nice. one more ask — add a smoke eval suite that specifically hits repeated-prefix KV patterns during AWQ calibration to prevent future blind spots.
maddie: noted. I'll add `calib-smoke-kv` to the AWQ pipeline and block merges with >0.5% accuracy delta on that suite. :thumbsup:
alex_ng: thanks folks — I'll follow up with PR for selector revert + flag.
